consequence.text: You commit to surveying the ground beyond the milestone yourself. Reporting to the watch is no longer your response to this discovery. You can now record the limits of your survey here.

consequence.text: You commit to bringing the uncertain trail to the watch instead of conducting a private survey. Return to Cinderwatch Gate to give your report.

consequence.text: You record your survey: the overlapping prints remain inconclusive. Your survey is now recorded; you have not warned the watch. You can return to the gate or continue investigating here.

consequence.text: The watch receives your report that the patrol trail becomes unclear at the milestone. The watch has now been warned; no private survey was conducted. You can continue your inquiry at the gate or return to the milestone.
